full_prompt_en: A square figurative painting presents two young workers from the waist up, standing side by side and looking directly outward. The figure on the left wears a brown checked cap, a dark brown jacket and a lighter apron over a high-necked shirt. One hand grips a straw broom that rises along the left edge. The figure on the right has a pale close-fitting cap above curled light hair, a reddish checked dress or smock, and a dark collar. A second broom handle rises beside the right shoulder. Both faces are pale with pink cheeks, small closed mouths and still, unsmiling expressions. The near symmetry of the pair is loosened by the different heights and warmer color of the clothing. Behind them, a muted town of rooftops and tall industrial chimneys recedes under a turquoise sky with large soft clouds. A smaller person appears between the two shoulders, and a crowd of barely defined heads occupies the hazy middle ground. The foreground figures have firm outlines and carefully modeled faces, while the city is arranged in flat, slightly softened geometric masses. Browns, dusty reds and cream dominate the clothing and skin; cool blue and gray carry the distant structures. Daylight is broad and diffuse, brightening the faces evenly and leaving modest shadows beneath the cap brims and around collars. Fine vertical brush marks and an aged, chalky grain remain visible across the surface. The upright brooms repeat the vertical chimneys, linking the workers to the built background. The composition holds its two quiet faces close to the viewer against a busy yet faded civic landscape, giving everyday labor a solemn, unadorned presence.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形人物绘画呈现两名并排站立、从腰部以上入画的年轻劳动者，他们直视画外。左边人物戴棕色格纹帽，穿深棕外套和较浅围裙，里面是高领上衣。一只手握住沿左缘升起的草扫帚。右边人物的浅色贴头帽下露出卷曲浅发，穿带红色格纹的衣裙或罩衣，领口深色。另一支扫帚柄从右肩旁向上。两张脸都浅白，双颊微粉，嘴巴小而闭合，神情静止且不笑。两人的近似对称被不同的身高和衣料暖色程度轻轻打破。身后，低饱和屋顶和高大工业烟囱构成城镇，退入一片带大块柔云的青蓝天空。两肩之间能看到一名更小的人物，朦胧中景中聚着一群难以分清的头部。前景人物轮廓稳固，面孔仔细塑形，城市则由略被柔化的扁平几何团块安排。棕色、灰红和奶油色支配衣服与皮肤；冷蓝、灰色承载远方建筑。日光宽阔漫射，均匀照亮面孔，只在帽檐下和领口周围留下适度阴影。细竖笔痕和古旧粉质颗粒在表面可见。直立扫帚呼应竖向烟囱，把劳动者与建筑背景联系起来。构图让两张安静面孔贴近观者，背后是忙碌却褪色的城市景观，使日常劳动呈现庄重、不加修饰的存在感。
style_prompt_en: The image has a matte, chalky painted surface with fine vertical marks and softly weathered color. Pale cream and dusty rose areas are modeled carefully, while broad brown, muted red and blue-gray fields remain flatter. Firm, simple contours define near forms; farther masses become hazier and smaller without losing their geometric rhythm. Light is cool and diffuse, giving even illumination with only modest shadow under projecting edges. Repeated upright lines link the foreground and background, setting a steady visual cadence. Near symmetry creates a formal center, but differences in height, tone and texture prevent rigidity. The spatial treatment is shallow in the front and opens into compressed layered distance. Worn grain and restrained color keep the surface humble and tactile rather than glossy. The whole image combines clear human scale, quiet frontal stillness and a softly accumulated built backdrop.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有哑光、粉质的绘画表面，细竖笔痕与轻微风化的颜色可见。浅奶油色和灰粉色部分经过仔细塑形，大片棕色、低饱和红和蓝灰色域则较平。稳固而简洁的轮廓界定近处形体；远处团块更小、更朦胧，却没有失去几何节奏。光冷而漫射，提供均匀照明，只在突出边缘下留下适度阴影。重复的竖线把前后景联系起来，建立稳定的视觉节拍。近似对称形成正式的中央结构，身高、色调和肌理差异又避免僵硬。空间处理在前部较浅，向压缩的层叠远方打开。磨旧颗粒和克制色彩让表面朴素可触，而非光亮。整幅图结合明确的人体尺度、安静的正面静止感和柔和堆叠的建筑背景。
theme_en: Two young workers in patterned caps hold brooms before a pale industrial city
theme_zh: 两名戴花纹帽的年轻劳动者手持扫帚，身后是一座浅色工业城市
name: Evelyn Dunbar
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
